body:
The bore must be at least 8 mm in radius -- the shaft interface.
Housing and cover have to agree on this; today each is checked
against the agreed figure separately.
The gearbox housing must not exceed 95 mm in length.

The assembled gearbox must not exceed 1.5 kg. This is the budget
the components are allocated out of.
The cover must not exceed 8 mm in thickness.
